records.text: aba-babaw laila ka murapun yami lia

senses.en: God will take care of us!
I am taking care of a child.
The old man is taking care of a child.
God was taking care of him.

records.text: naki a rakihan rapunen ni tata

senses.zh: 我的小孩被阿姨照顧了
senses.en: My child is taken care of by the aunt.

records.text: naki a rakihan rapunun ni hakezeng a saw

senses.zh: 我的小孩托給一個老人照顧
senses.en: My child is/was taken care of by an old person.

records.text: yaku kalu paray sarapun naki a rakihan

senses.en: I take care of my child with money.

records.text: arai adang a tauxumak, aunu sarapun awi

senses.en: Take another girl to wife, so that she can take care of Awi.

records.text: arai adang a tauxumak aunu sarapun u rakihan

senses.en: Take another wife to take care of the baby.
